description: Agent Feedback: submit one piece of feedback on a specific piece of work, point by point: optionally the giver and the work, and each point with its id, the point as written, its tone (praise, criticism, a suggestion, a question or mixed, read from wording such as great job or confusing when left out), the specific part of the work it is about, what it says is wrong or right there, the change it states or implies, whether it is about something outside the receiver’s control, whether it presents that as the receiver’s own defect, and the ids of other points whose instruction it contradicts. The signed report gives every point as actionable, nothing_to_act_on, misplaced_blame, conflicting, unlocated, no_change or unconfirmed, with every pair of contradicting instructions, and names feedback that leaves the receiver nothing clear to act on: every point pure praise or pure complaint with no part of the work and no change named, something outside the receiver’s control presented as their defect, and two instructions in the same feedback that contradict each other; then some such points among actionable ones, a change with no part named and a criticism of a part with no change, with the fix for each. This reads whether a receiver can act on feedback, not scoring or benchmarking: grading an agent’s output against a rubric is wever_evaluation-scoring-check, and a collision between agents’ recorded actions on shared work is wever_coordination-conflict-check. Verdict feedback_unactionable, feedback_actionability_gaps, feedback_actionability_unverified or feedback_actionable. POST /api/feedback-actionability-check. Reads only the recorded feedback material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no feedback is sent, no party is contacted and no work is changed. Agent Feedback reads the working feedback loop on one piece of work between a giver and a receiver: it is not scoring or benchmarking (the wever_evaluation checks), not a durable standing record (the wever_reputation checks) and not how agents organize shared work (the wever_coordination checks). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-feedback-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-feedback/.

items.description: Each point in one piece of feedback.

as_defect.description: The point presents it as the receiver’s own defect.

change.description: The change the point states or implies, such as re-pull the total from the ledger.

contradicts.description: Ids of other items in this feedback whose instruction this one contradicts.

id.description: The item id, such as f1.

observation.description: What the point says is wrong or right there.

outside_control.description: The point is about something outside the receiver’s control, such as a platform outage or a policy someone else sets.

part.description: The specific part of the work the point is about, such as the travel total on page 2.

tone.description: Praise, criticism, a suggestion, a question or mixed; read from the wording when left out.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

name: wever_feedback-actionability-check
title: Feedback actionability check
